ValidationRule.description: Throws error if the Case Record Type is ATM Dispute or Card Dispute and not in the Card Disputes - General Queue or Card Disputes - Fraud Queue.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'ATM_Dispute', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Card_Dispute'), OR( NOT(Queue__c = 'Card Disputes - General Queue'), NOT(Queue__c = 'Card Disputes - Fraud Queue'), NOT(ISNULL(Queue__c)))
)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: For this Dispute Type, please select either Card Disputes - General Queue or Card Disputes - Fraud Queue.
